title: Atlas Coffee Club Alternatives: 5 Boxes Like Atlas - Cratejoy
summary: Looking for an Atlas Coffee Club alternative? Compare five coffee subscriptions by price, roast choice, and format, from single-origin clubs to K-cups.
body_markdown:
## Questions before switching


Which alternative is closest to Atlas Coffee Club?


MyBean Monthly. Each box holds two single-origin coffees from different growing regions, 12 ounces in all, with tasting notes, brewing tips, and fun facts. It keeps Atlas's coffee-from-somewhere-new idea, though it sends no postcard and delivers monthly only.


Is there a coffee subscription cheaper than Atlas?


Bell Lap Coffee, at $12.95 a month for one 12-ounce bag, costs less than an Atlas bag at around $14. You choose the roast and grind, but the coffee comes from Bell Lap's own roasts, not a new country each month.


Is there an Atlas-style coffee club for K-cups?


Single Cup Club sends 15 K-cups a month in three blends from sponsored roasters, flavored, non-flavored, or mixed, for $19.99. Atlas also sells its own pod plan if you want single-origin coffee in pods.


Can I send one of these as a gift?


Yes. Each Cratejoy box can be given as a gift from its listing page, and gift orders don't renew. The seller ships on its own schedule, so check the listing's ship window before you plan around a date.
